articles.title: ROBERT HARDMAN: How happy-clappy rewilders, wilfully ignoring centuries of wisdom and experience, are making Britain a tinderbox
articles.summary: From Suffolk to the Peak District to the Cairngorms, pockets of fires are still furtively flickering away, smokeless, unseen and underfoot, in roots, animal burrows or a seam of peat.
